call_points.text: Order book targeted at about ₹2,500 Cr by FY27-end, after current-year execution.
₹177.5 Cr MoD order for tank and crew gunnery simulator upgradation received after quarter-end.
₹700-800 Cr of simulator orders in the pipeline, expected over the next few months.
Cash and bank balances about ₹1,217 Cr; group remains debt free.
Anti-drone and simulator order softness is demand-side: no tenders floated recently, management says.
Vector Technics propulsion capacity expanded to about 300,000 units; potential revenue cited at about ₹300 Cr if orders come.
Robotics and autonomous vehicles will take at least two to three years to mature; simulators and anti-drone drive the next one to two years.
Management is looking to acquire more companies, funded from remaining QIP proceeds and built-up cash.
Management reiterated its revenue projection of ₹4,000 Cr cumulative for FY27 and FY28.
Long-term operational margins guided at 35% EBITDA and 25% PAT.
HyperStrike interceptor drone production capability built for 5,000 per shift/month, scalable to 15,000.
Bidding pipeline currently stands around ₹1,500 Cr, with additional single-vendor opportunities.

A penalty of 200% amounting to Rs. 54.04 lakhs along with interest of Rs. 2.70 lakhs was imposed, resulting in a total liability of Rs. 56.74 lakhs on account of disallowance of R&D expenditure u/s 35(2AB) pertaining to Assessment Year 2018-19. Under the DTVSV Scheme, the penalty was reduced to 25%, i.e., Rs. 13.51 lakhs. As the Department had already adjusted the total penalty amount of Rs. 56.74 lakhs against the refund for AY 2021-22. Consequently, the actual refund due now amounts to Rs. 43.23 lakhs (Rs. 56.74 lakhs - Rs. 13.51 lakhs) in DTVSVS. As per FORM 2 under the DTVSV Scheme, the Income Tax Department has certified a refund claim of Rs. 40.53 lakhs only. FORM 3 along with withdrawal of appeal has been submitted on 30-01-205 under DTVSVS as part of the compliance process. Form 4 issued by CIT on 16-04-2025, refund is still not credited to bank account

guidance.statement: Targeting ₹4,000 Cr cumulative turnover in FY27 and FY28 put together
ARI and UTS together target ₹365 Cr revenue in FY27
Long-term operational EBITDA margin maintained at 35%
Full year operational EBITDA margin expected in the mid-30s
Order book expected to end FY27 at around ₹2,500 Cr after execution
Cumulative revenue of ₹4,000 Cr targeted across FY2027 and FY2028, of which about ₹2,000 Cr from simulators

operating_notes.text: Order book stood at ₹1,336.04 crores as of March 31, 2026.
New order inflows of ₹431 crore in Q4FY26; consolidated order book ₹1,336 crore at FY26-end, mostly for FY27 execution.
Launched India's first AI-powered fully integrated anti-drone system with multi-configuration deployment capabilities.
Unveiled a suite of new defence products including AI-powered anti-drone systems, cybersecurity suite, unmanned ground vehicles, and directed energy weapons at North Tech Symposium 2026.
Bidding pipeline stands at ~₹1,500 Cr alongside additional single-vendor opportunities.
Out of ₹1,336 Cr total order book as of March 31, 2026, ~₹1,000 Cr is scheduled for execution in FY27.
Unveiled Integrated Smart Border Suite (ISBS) comprising anti-drone systems, loitering munitions, interceptor drones, UGVs, RCWS, and thermal surveillance.
Consolidated order book of ₹1,239 Cr at June 30, 2026 split into ₹920.6 Cr equipment and ₹318.4 Cr AMC.
Gross margin was 72.9% in Q1FY27, broadly flat sequentially and year-on-year, with the EBITDA fall attributed to operating leverage on a fixed cost base.
Management estimates the army and navy simulator market at upwards of about $2.5 billion, roughly ₹25,000 Cr.
Zen Technologies agreed to acquire a 51.98% stake in Cogknit Semantics Private Limited for up to ₹135.15 Cr.
Cogknit's BMS won the iDEX challenge for Main Battle Tanks, received the Raksha Mantri's Award for Innovation in 2022 and has completed field trials with the Indian Army.
Zen's ₹135.15 Cr for 51.98% of Cogknit is split between a primary subscription and purchase of existing shares, with Ashish Kacholia and associates also in the primary round.
Fire incident at UTS production centre in Hyderabad caused estimated damage of up to ₹4 crore, covered by insurance.

timeline.summary: Zen Technologies announced postal ballot voting results on April 28, 2026, approving related party transactions and re-appointing key leadership.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹178.08 Cr (-45.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.53 Cr.
Zen Technologies reported Q4FY26 results: revenue ₹178.08 Cr; PAT ₹31.53 Cr; order book ₹1,336 Cr with ₹431 Cr Q4 inflows.
Sourav Dhar, Chief Financial Officer, announced the earnings conference call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 4, 2026, available at the company’s website.
Zen Technologies unveiled India's first AI-powered fully integrated anti-drone system on May 5, 2026.
Zen Technologies unveiled seven new defence products and solutions at the North Tech Symposium 2026 in Prayagraj.
Zen Technologies filed its QIP Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹703.8 Cr utilised out of ₹979.5 Cr net proceeds.
Zen Technologies held its Q4FY26 earnings call, reiterating its ₹4,000 Cr cumulative revenue target for FY27-FY28 and introducing new AI defence products.
Zen Technologies launched its Integrated Smart Border Suite (ISBS) targeting India's planned 6,000 km smart border security initiative.
Ashok Atluri, Promoter of Zen Technologies Limited, declares no encumbrance on shares by Promoters or Promoter Group for FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
Zen Technologies' Q1FY27 call (July 27, 2026) reported revenue of ₹141.6 Cr; an operational EBITDA margin of 27.3%; and an order book of ₹1,239 Cr at June 30, 2026.
2026-10-17: Zen Technologies approved the acquisition of a 51.98% stake in Cogknit Semantics Private Limited for up to ₹135.15 Cr.

2026-10-18: Zen Technologies issued a press release on its board-approved ₹135.15 Cr investment for a 51.98% fully diluted stake in Cogknit Semantics, a Bengaluru BMS developer whose system has completed Indian Army field trials.
Zen Technologies reported a fire incident at subsidiary Unistring Tech Solutions with estimated losses up to ₹4 crore covered by insurance.

watchlist.response: MD attributed it to demand, not capability: no anti-drone or simulator tenders have been floated recently, and fast-track tenders are expected in a few months.
